mentions.name: MakerPort
mentions.description: A microcontroller board for makers, similar to an Arduino or micro:bit, programmable with the MicroBlocks editor. The hardware includes an MP3 player, I2C ports, an accelerometer, and true capacitive touch sensors.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working with a group of friends on a "microcontroller-for-makers" kind of thing called the MakerPort. (https://makerport.fun) Sort of similar to an Arduino or micro:bit, but uses the MicroBlocks programming editor (https://microblocks.fun) created by John Maloney, who was the original team leader for Scratch at MIT for 11 years. The hardware includes an mp3 player, I2C ports, accelerometer and true capacitive touch sensors.
